title: Crane symbols match Sheehan's drawings
place_text: Naval Surface Warfare Center Crane, Indiana

tellings.quote: what he had draw is very close to what I seen

plain: A man named Randy Anderson says that around 2014, at Naval Surface Warfare Center Crane, a US Navy site in Indiana, he saw symbols he links to technology that was not human. He told podcast host Jesse Michels that drawings made by another man, Dan Sheehan, are "very close" to what he saw. If true, it would mean two people separately describing the same markings.
